Two weeks ago, we stayed again at the Titanic Deluxe Belek. We had stayed at this hotel three years ago as well and were quite satisfied then. Therefore, our expectations were quite high this year. Unfortunately, however, the hotel was a big disappointment for us this time.

I think the quality of service has seriously declined in recent years. We unfortunately did not see the service and quality expected from a 5-star hotel this year.

We generally disliked the food this time. We felt that the preparation of the food was not as high-quality and meticulous as before. We were particularly dissatisfied with the service of the waiters in the Hasır Restaurant. Some waiters were quite cold, indifferent, and even arrogant. They gave the impression of considering themselves superior to the guests. Moreover, this attitude was not only towards adults but also towards children.

The hygiene in the restaurant was also a major negative point for us. While eating, we saw food on the floor and even ants crawling on it. Encountering such a sight during a meal was truly unpleasant. We would expect much more attention to cleanliness and hygiene in a 5-star hotel. This is a complete zero for us.

We also had problems with beverage service several times. For example, several people are sitting at a table, and one of us gets up to get food. The waiter comes and asks what we want to drink. For example, we ask for three drinks, but then only two are brought. This happened several times. This gave us the impression that they were trying to save money on beverage service.

Another negative point is that they no longer provide bottled or canned drinks. Drinks are poured into glasses elsewhere and brought to you, and you can't even see what brand they are. Frankly, we expect a much different and higher quality service from a 5-star hotel.

The only positive thing we can say is that the staff at the Kids Club were very friendly and attentive to the children. We thank them for that.

Overall, our experience this year was very different from our experience three years ago. We hope the hotel takes this feedback seriously. Because we think the current service, hygiene, and hospitality are not befitting a 5-star hotel.

We hope these issues will be corrected in the future.

Disappointment instead of 5-star luxury – outdated, overcrowded, and inadequate service

I absolutely cannot recommend the Titanic Deluxe Golf. Don't be fooled by older, positive reviews – for us as a family of four, the stay was a complete disappointment. You don't feel like a valued guest here, but merely like a number in a mass-market establishment.

The points of criticism in detail:
Unacceptable room size & defects: As a family of four, we were crammed into an extremely small room. Next to the main area, three beds were crammed together – we felt completely trapped. Upon arrival, the safe was broken, and we had to wait ages for a technician instead of being able to enjoy the day by the pool.

Serious safety risk in the bathroom: The most dangerous incident occurred in the shower: The heavy glass door jumped out of its track and almost fell on my son! Furthermore, the ventilation is ineffective, so the entire bathroom is completely soaked and fogged up after every shower. There were also hygiene issues (e.g., dirty light switches/buttons).

Poor service & cleaning: Our assigned "personal assistant" merely escorted us to our room – there was no guidance or useful information about the resort. Furthermore, our room wasn't cleaned until 5:00 PM on one occasion, even though we had vacated it at 9:00 AM.

Handling of complaints: Despite numerous serious complaints, the response was laughable. I was simply offered a meal at an à la carte restaurant – and even that was the cheapest of the four restaurants. Given the price range and the issues we encountered, I find this outrageous.

Conclusion & course of the stay: While the gardens are visually appealing and the food tastes okay, this doesn't salvage the overall impression. The hotel is noticeably outdated, run-down, completely overcrowded, and offers absolutely no 5-star experience. We will definitely not be returning.

Yorum Metni:
Negative aspects
1. There are a lot of flies. They bit us all over at every event, and those without allergy medication or cream should definitely bring some beforehand. (They apparently provide cream etc. if you want it, but it should have been in the rooms from the start. We only found out about this by word of mouth on the last day.)
2. Trips to the sea are by shuttle or sea transport. They run every 2-3 minutes, so you don't wait long, but the return trips end at 7 PM. So you can't really enjoy the sea a little longer.
3. They open the sofas as children's beds in the rooms, so there are no extra beds. The children slept next to us instead of on the sofa and said they were very uncomfortable.
4. The nightlife is insufficient. The evening entertainment is good. There's only a disco on the boat on certain days. This was really great, but it ends early and there's no after-party.
5. Note for those who don't like choppy seas: The sea is generally choppy.
6. Snack bars and other restaurants open and close at the same time. Customers should not stay in any specific time slot.
Positive aspects:
1. Breakfast and meals are fantastic.
2. Evening entertainment is great.
3. Alcoholic beverages are good.
4. The QR system on the beach is very good and fast.
5. The à la carte restaurants and entertainment are great.
6. The steam rooms, sauna, Turkish bath, and cold water areas were enjoyable.
7. The pools are fantastic.
8. The aqua park is quite adequate.

My highest rating: The waiters, staff, bartenders, etc., are all friendly and do their jobs wonderfully. I congratulate and thank them all.

It met with my expectations since I wasn't looking for  ultra high quality.

Some of the other reviews don't sound fair to me. If you book a room near river side please expect bee and mosquitoes around you. There is literally nothing wrong here.

Food options are fitting every single person type but some meat offerings are requiring waiting in the line around 5-6 minutes. You can't complain about the food as every corner has options till 3AM.

A La Carte options are also really good and my favorite is Yamas as the show goes really top.

Shows are also fairly good. I highly recommend Madonna show if you ever get chance. Bikes in fire ball could be also amazing but it was a bit too much for my 3yo kid.

With a small kid, never had any issue food options. All places were safe enough. Kids Club is expecting at least 4yo to have them without parent supervision. But staff was kind to give a try as my kid has no diaper requirements. Kid shows are also good but could be best fit after 5yo.

Beach has some experience but it is not my best choice. Food options around the beach is also good.

Main Lobby has drink offering between 9am till midnight. Patisserie is also another great area with AC. Outside sitting area and main square are also great but could be still hot till 8pm.

Staff speaks English, Russian, Turkish quite well and respect each and every wishes you may have.

Elif and Hasan from customer service helped us via WhatsApp in super fast ways. We also met with Esra Nur from Patisserie area, she was quite welcoming and friendly to us and our kid.

Location is a bit far from city center but you don't need anything from center. If required, you can order online or request from customer service.

Rooms are getting cleaned every day as it is important but balconies are not super great. If you are smoker then it makes sense but I never stayed at balcony as it was only for chairs and small table.
